name: Vaippar

source.name: Varushanadu Hills, near Sivagiri, Western Ghats

sink.name: Gulf of Mannar, near Vaippar village

did_you_know: The Vaippar flows through some of Tamil Nadu's driest districts, where it is largely dependent on the northeast monsoon and runs for only a limited number of days a year in its lower reaches.
Its waters are important for salt-pan production near the coast in Thoothukudi district.
The proposed Pamba-Achankovil-Vaippar link would divert monsoon surplus from Kerala's Pamba and Achankovil rivers into the Vaippar basin — a long-debated interstate river-linking proposal.
